p: CardSwap helps trading-card collectors keep track of their collection, list cards they would sell or trade, discover cards, and message each other directly.
CardSwap is not a buyer, seller or intermediary in any transaction. We do not process payments, hold funds, guarantee, escrow, ship, or confirm that any transaction took place.
You sign in with Google and are responsible for activity on your account. One person, one account.
You must be legally able to arrange transactions yourself, or have a parent/guardian's consent.
Listings must honestly describe a card you actually own, with real photos of that card.
Do not list counterfeits, proxies presented as genuine, stolen goods, or anything on the Prohibited Items list.
Any agreement on price, trade, payment or handover is between users. CardSwap is not responsible for quality, authenticity, delivery or payment.
Please read the Safety tips before dealing.
We may hide or remove content, and suspend or terminate accounts that break these Terms or the Community Guidelines.
You can contest a moderation decision via the contact email in the footer.
CardSwap is an independent project, not affiliated with Nintendo, The Pokémon Company, Creatures or Game Freak. Card names and images belong to their respective owners.
From Google: email, name and avatar (to create your account).
What you provide: username, display name, bio, approximate city, collection, card photos, listings, wishlist, messages, reports.
Technical: session data and per-day de-duplicated listing views.
Home addresses, mandatory phone numbers, government ID, bank accounts or payment details. Photos are compressed on your device and stripped of location data (EXIF/GPS) before upload.
To run your account, show public profiles and listings, deliver messages between collectors, prevent abuse and moderate content.
Public: profile, public binders, listings, public wishlist.
Private: messages are visible only to conversation members; chat photos are stored privately. Reports are visible only to moderators.
Processors: Supabase (database, auth, storage) and our hosting provider.

View and edit your profile any time, and permanently delete your account in Settings. Deletion removes your profile, collection, listings and photos; messages you sent remain visible to recipients as “Deleted collector”.
Describe condition accurately, photograph the actual card, disclose grading and print defects.
No harassment, insults, discrimination or pressure. Declining an offer is everyone's right.
No bulk messaging, duplicate listings or advertising outside services.
Sharing contact details is your choice. Never share passwords or one-time codes.
Use Report for violations and Block when you don't want contact. Listings with several reports are hidden until a moderator reviews them.
Counterfeits, fakes, or proxy/custom cards presented as genuine.
Stolen goods or items without lawful provenance.
Game accounts, digital codes, pack-opening services, raffles or lotteries.
Anything that is not a trading card you actually own.
Check the other collector's profile, membership age and other listings.
Ask for more photos (back, edges, a photo with a handwritten username) if needed.
Pick a busy public place (a café or card shop). Inspect the card carefully before exchanging.
CardSwap does not process payment or shipping. Agree terms clearly in chat and weigh the risk before sending money or cards.
Never share passwords, one-time codes or sensitive financial information.
Report the user or listing and block if needed. For fraud, contact the authorities.
